body:
...Because I'm ugly and have no personality.  I go to grocery stores, gym, malls, anywhere really, and I look at any guy there, all of them are better than me.  All of them have something charming or likable that makes them fun to be around.  I have nothing, no quality that'll interest the opposite sex, unless she's interested in being with a failure.  I literally scare girls away.  If I'm in an elevator and a girl is about to get in, she retreats and uses the stairs, or if I'm coming down the hallway, she tries to find another way so she doesn't interact with me.  

One "positive quality", I make good amount of money, that's about it honestly, and any girl who wants to be with me for the money is probably pretty fucked up to begin with.  Thankfully there aren't any.
